title: Content catalog
summary: 84 scenes by category, 8 enemies, roster and companions.
bodyHtml:
Scenes: 84

By category:

  • Hazards: 11
  • Strangers: 15
  • Finds: 7
  • Haze events: 5
  • Oddities: 3
  • Respites: 3
  • Crises: 5
  • Quarrels: 9
  • Landmarks: 5
  • Route scenes: 4
  • Companion scenes: 17

Source files: src/game/content/scenes/ (hazards.ts, strangers.ts, finds.ts, people.ts, landmarks.ts, companions.ts, merged in index.ts) and src/game/content/route-scenes.ts. Content integrity is checked by test/content.test.ts.

Enemies: 8

Raiders, toll thugs, mob, Hollowed pack, single Hollowed, Haze hounds, the Long Man, the Turned. Defined in src/game/content/enemies.ts. See Combat.

People

  • Roster: 12 people plus four founder backgrounds (content/roster.ts).
  • Named companions: 9 (content/npcs.ts). See Companions.

Map

Four forks, twelve route nodes, 840 miles. See Route map, forks and misleading maps.

Endings

Four, all earned by the run, resolved at the Gate (src/game/ending.ts).
